key: Koplenig, Kupietz & Wolfer 2022, Testing the relationship between word length, frequency, and predictability based on the German Reference Corpus (osf.io/nrebj)
evidence: Opened 2026-10-22 because Piantadosi, Tily & Gibson 2011 (predictability, not frequency, predicts word length) is contested by Meylan & Griffiths 2021, and this paper ships OSF data and code for a third test. No suspicion about this paper itself; chosen for the dispute and the deposit.
